task.title: Create a TPU VM
task.shortdesc: Create a TPU VM for one generation. The command and software version depend on the generation, so build this topic with that generation's DITAVAL file.

data.name: licence
data.value: CC BY 4.0. Adapted from the source page and modified: restructured as DITA, values moved to keys.

prereq.p: You have a Google Cloud project with the Cloud TPU API enabled and quota in your chosen zone.

info.codeblock: gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create TPU_NAME \ --zone=ZONE \ --accelerator-type=ACCELERATOR_TYPE \ --version=
gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create TPU_NAME \ --zone=ZONE \ --accelerator-type=ACCELERATOR_TYPE \ --version=
gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create TPU_NAME \ --zone=ZONE \ --accelerator-type=ACCELERATOR_TYPE \ --version=

step.cmd: Create capacity with GKE or Compute Engine, using the machine type.
To keep the VM off the public internet, add the --internal-ips flag.

result.p: The VM appears in the list returned by gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm list --zone=ZONE.
